title: Preferred Conformation-Guided Discovery of Potent and Orally Active HIF Prolyl Hydroxylase 2 Inhibitors for the Treatment of Anemia.
authors: Wu, Yue; Zhang, Linjian; Sun, Zhuoli; Qiu, Xusheng; Chen, Yafen; Su, Kaijun; Yang, Le; Du, Zhongqiu; Dong, Ying; Yang, Fulai; Li, Xiang; Zhang, Xiaojin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PHD2小分子抑制剂设计，对象为酶-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this work, we discovered a novel series of prolyl hydroxylase 2 (PHD2) inhibitors with improved metabolic properties based on a preferred conformation-guided drug design strategy. Piperidinyl-containing linkers with preferred metabolic stability were designed to match the dihedral angle of the desired docking conformation in the PHD2 binding site with the lowest energy conformation. Based on the piperidinyl-containing linkers, a series of PHD2 inhibitors with high PHD2 affinity and favorable druggability were obtained. Remarkably, compound 22, with an IC(50) of 22.53 nM toward PHD2, significantly stabilized hypoxia-inducible factor alpha (HIF-alpha) and upregulated the expression of erythropoietin (EPO). Furthermore, oral administration of 22 dose-dependently stimulated erythropoiesis in vivo. Preliminary preclinical studies showed that 22 has good pharmacokinetic properties and an excellent safety profile, even at 10 times the efficacious dose (200 mg/kg). Taken together, these results indicate that 22 is a promising candidate for anemia treatment.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们基于优选构象引导的药物设计策略，发现了一系列具有改善代谢特性的新型脯氨酰羟化酶2（PHD2）抑制剂。设计了含有哌啶基的连接子，其具有优选的代谢稳定性，以匹配PHD2结合位点中预期对接构象的最低能量构象的二面角。基于含哌啶基的连接子，获得了一系列具有高PHD2亲和力和良好成药性的PHD2抑制剂。值得注意的是，化合物22对PHD2的IC(50)为22.53 nM，显著稳定了缺氧诱导因子α（HIF-alpha）并上调了促红细胞生成素（EPO）的表达。此外，口服给予22在体内剂量依赖性地刺激红细胞生成。初步临床前研究表明，即使在10倍有效剂量（200 mg/kg）下，22也具有良好的药代动力学特性和优异的安全性。综合这些结果，表明22是治疗贫血的有前景的候选药物。
